definitions.explanation: Plants in general, especially the combination of grasses and trees that make up natural vegetation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{草木|そうもく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}く→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, the plants begin to sprout.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草木|そうもく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I tended to the plants in the garden.

examples.japanese: {草木|そうもく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦{丑三|うしみ}つ{時|どき}→丑三つ時：10089_ushimitsudoki⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{静|しず}けさ→静けさ：14614_shizukesa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧だ。
examples.english: There's the expression 'the hour when even the plants sleep,' which describes the stillness of the dead of night.

notes:
A Sino-Japanese reading of {草|そう} (grass) + {木|もく} (tree). This is the on'yomi reading, used in more literary, formal, or set expression contexts. The same kanji can also be read {草木|くさき} (kun'yomi), which is the more colloquial reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草木|そうもく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧ — vegetation grows thick
- {草木|そうもく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧ — vegetation withers
- {草木|そうもく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}く→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧ — plants bud/sprout
- {草木|そうもく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ — even the plants sleep (set phrase for dead of night)

RELATED READING:
- {草木|くさき} — the same kanji read with kun'yomi; more colloquial and used in everyday speech to refer to trees and grass. The そうもく reading is more literary.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ — plants (botanical/scientific term); more formal and includes all plants, not just visible vegetation
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ — greenery; focuses on the visual aspect of green plants
- ⟦{植生|しょくせい}→植生：28236_shokusei⟧ — vegetation (ecological term); technical term for the plant life of a region
